title: AsterixPay - API integration check-in
next_steps: Redwood to open a support ticket with repro details and request request-ids
AsterixPay to share a few failing request timestamps + region
Dev to check OpenAI-compat streaming path for early disconnects
transcript:
Meeting header
Date: 2025-02-11
Duration: 46m
Attendees: Lauren Bishop (Redwood), Dev Patel (Redwood), Mara Lin (AsterixPay), Jon Keller (AsterixPay)

Transcript
[00:00] Lauren Bishop: cool, thanks for jumping on. I saw the note about streaming behaving weirdly. can you describe what you’re seeing?
[00:12] Mara Lin: yeah. We’re using your OpenAI compatible endpoint, like `/v1/chat/completions`, `stream=true`. Intermittently the stream just… stops. Like no `[DONE]` event. The socket closes and we get an incomplete assistant message on our side.
[00:34] Dev Patel: it’s a disconnect or a stall?
[00:37] Mara Lin: both. Usually we see tokens for a few seconds then nothing for ~10-20 seconds then connection drops. Sometimes it just ends early.
[00:53] Jon Keller: It happens more in EU. We’re hitting eu-west mostly because of our data residency stuff.
[01:04] Dev Patel: are you going through a proxy on your side? or direct from the app?
[01:08] Jon Keller: Cloudflare in front, but we tested bypassing it and still saw it once.
[01:16] Mara Lin: We are using the OpenAI SDK in Node. We swapped to raw fetch + SSE parsing and still got a couple premature endings.
[01:30] Lauren Bishop: and just to be explicit, this is Redwood hosted, not Dedicated, right?
[01:34] Mara Lin: hosted for now.
[01:38] Dev Patel: do you have request ids for a few failures? we can trace in the gateway.
[01:44] Mara Lin: yep. We have `x-request-id` from headers. Example: `req_9f1c...` around 2025-02-10 21:13 UTC.
[02:01] Dev Patel: ok. in our OpenAI-compat path we do SSE over HTTP/1.1. If something is buffering or an idle timeout kicks in, you can see partial streams.
[02:16] Mara Lin: the annoying part is it looks like success until it’s not. We don’t always get a non-200. Just a truncated stream.
[02:28] Lauren Bishop: impact wise? is this blocking launch?
[02:33] Mara Lin: it’s like 0.5% of requests but those are user-visible. We can retry but then we double charge tokens.
[02:44] Dev Patel: understood. for now, could you try a slightly more aggressive client-side read timeout? and log when you don’t see `[DONE]`.
[02:56] Mara Lin: we can. But we mostly need server-side fix.
[03:01] Dev Patel: yep. We’ll open a ticket. Also if you can include whether you see a final SSE event with `finish_reason` or it just cuts.
[03:13] Jon Keller: it just cuts. no final event.
[03:19] Lauren Bishop: ok. We’ll follow up in email with a support ticket number and keep you posted.
[45:20] Lauren Bishop: recap: AsterixPay sees intermittent premature stream termination on OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` in eu-west. You’ll send 3-5 request ids and timestamps. We’ll investigate gateway timeouts/buffering and get back with workaround + ETA.
